degenerateReason: aOptionalString follows the omitted convention, so == null is a missing-attribute error for every NULL row and false for every other; CEL denies every seed.
intent: == null on an attribute that is omitted, not sent as null, when its column is NULL.
trap: The wire node is identical to an explicit-null equality, so defaulting to that convention emits IS NULL and returns five rows the PDP denies; under the omitted convention it must throw (#302).
